passages.text: Highlights of Python 3.15 include lazy imports, faster JIT compilation, better error messages, and smarter profiling.

But note that further development on the JIT is now subject to some firmly laid-out guidelines regarding the performance improvement it needs to provide before it can be considered a fully supported part of Python, and not just an experimental sideline.
Python 3.15 is now officially released, and I'd like to share some of my favorite new features.
